subject: Executive recap: procurement gates, pilot boundary conditions, and escalation items
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@retailco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Executive recap: procurement gates, pilot boundary conditions, and escalation items

Ethan / Priya \u2014 thanks again for your time this morning. Below is a leadership-friendly recap and a short action list so both teams can brief their execs without a long thread. I kept it intentionally concise.

Quick summary:
- Business outcome: target a 30% reduction in per-recommendation inference cost and ~40% improvement in p99 latency for recommendations (pilot to validate).
- Procurement anchor: RetailCo requires SOC 2 artifacts and a named vendor-risk POC to move forward.
- Short-term commercial ask: approval-in-principle for a capped burst SLA exception during the pilot to simulate peak traffic.

Key pain points called out on the call:
- Unexpected cost during Black Friday peaks.
- Tail latency spikes that reduce personalization CTR.
- Procurement needs an evidence map for controls; timeline pressure from infra freeze in late August.

Proposed pilot scope (high level):
1) 6-week pilot on dedicated capacity covering ~5% of recommendation traffic. First 2 weeks: read-only shadowing; then canary ramp over 3 weeks.
2) Reserved baseline capacity with a predefined burst cap for simulated peak windows (e.g., 4-hour Black Friday test).
3) Success metrics: p99 < 200ms, >=30% cost improvement per 1M requests, stable availability during burst.

Open leadership items / asks:
- Procurement: provide vendor-risk contact and confirm if NDA is required to receive the full SOC2 report (not just checklist) \u2014 ETA 6/17.
- Finance: confirm acceptable overage rate and a hard cap for pilot bursts so we can include rates in the procurement 1-pager.
- Engineering alignment: RetailCo to confirm infra cutover window (we heard 8/23 as the latest to support a September pilot).

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Redwood (Vanessa): share the customer demo deck and SOC2 evidence checklist (attached) \u2014 6/14 EOD.
- RetailCo (Ethan/Priya): confirm vendor-risk POC + indicate NDA requirement \u2014 6/17.
- Redwood/Trading eng sync (Ben/Karthik): 30-min tech deep-dive to size pilot capacity \u2014 schedule by 6/18.
- Redwood (Marissa/Ben): provide 1-pager for procurement with capped-burst commercial language and SLA-exception wording \u2014 6/18 EOD.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

If anything above is inaccurate or missing, please flag and I will update. Otherwise, please confirm the procurement POC by 6/17 so we can prioritize evidence collection on our side.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@retailco.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive recap: procurement gates, pilot boundary conditions, and escalation items

Thanks Vanessa \u2014 clear and helpful. A couple clarifications from procurement/security:

1) Vendor-risk POC: I'll share the vendor-risk manager contact by 6/17. Note they will want the full SOC2 report and an evidence map that ties controls to artifacts. The checklist is useful but not sufficient for their review.

2) Pilot burst pricing: can Redwood provide an example overage rate (per-1M token delta) and a suggested hard cap? Finance needs numbers to model risk.

3) Timeline constraint: our infra freeze begins on 2027-08-30. If we want a September pilot, the infra cut needs to be done by 2027-08-23. Please confirm Redwood engineering can hold that date if procurement gives acceptance-in-principle.

I'll confirm the vendor-risk contact by COB 2027-06-17. Also attaching our internal procurement checklist (for context).

-Ethan Morris
VP, Personalization & Recommendations | RetailCo

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@retailco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive recap: procurement gates, pilot boundary conditions, and escalation items 

Quick pilot strawman to address procurement and burst concerns:

Pilot blueprint (6 weeks):
- Scope: 5% recommendation traffic; 2 weeks read-only shadow; 4-week canary (ramp + measurement).
- Capacity: reserved baseline sized for steady-state plus a configurable burst window (example costs in deck).
- Success criteria: p99 < 200ms, cost delta of -30% per 1M requests, no availability issues during burst window.

Commercial asks for RetailCo execs:
1) Approval-in-principle of capped overage rate for pilot bursts (Ben/Marissa to provide sample language).
2) Short-term SLA exception to permit burst without penalty up to the agreed cap.

I'll draft a procurement-facing 1-pager and run it by Ethan/Priya in a 30-min call. Available windows: 2027-06-18 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@retailco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive recap: procurement gates, pilot boundary conditions, and escalation items 

Ethan / Priya \u2014 two quick leadership asks from our side. We appreciate the procurement clarity.

1) SOC2 evidence: we will provide the evidence map and supporting artifacts by 2027-06-17. If your vendor-risk manager requires the full SOC2 report, an NDA will be needed; we can execute quickly.

2) SLA exception: if RetailCo can indicate acceptance-in-principle for a capped burst for the pilot, Redwood will lock engineering availability for an 2027-08-23 infra cut. Without acceptance-in-principle, our earliest delivery moves to October.

Action items for RetailCo (please confirm by 2027-06-17):
- Share vendor-risk POC (name, email, phone).
- Indicate whether an NDA is required for the full SOC2 report.
- Confirm acceptance-in-principle of capped burst SLA exception for the pilot.

Vanessa / Ben / Karthik: we will draft the procurement 1-pager and an SLA appendix (ETA 2027-06-18 EOD). Attachment referenced: SLA-exception-ask.docx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success & Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
